about.heading: Meet Handyman TJ
about.lead: Built in Brooklyn on clean work, level lines, and zero shortcuts.
paragraphs: With 5 years of hands-on experience across New York City apartments, brownstones, and commercial spaces, I founded Handyman TJ to deliver dependable craftsmanship you can invite into your home with confidence.
Every appointment includes proper wall anchors for NYC plaster, brick, or metal studs, floor and furniture protection, and full cleanup before we leave. We are fully insured and background-checked.

faqs.q: What areas in New York do you serve?
faqs.a: Handyman TJ is based in Brooklyn (1780 West 3rd Street, NY 11223) and serves all five NYC boroughs — Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Staten Island, and the Bronx — as well as Nassau County on Long Island.

faqs.q: Can you mount TVs, heavy mirrors, and IKEA PAX closets on NYC plaster, brick, or metal studs?
faqs.a: Yes. NYC pre-war plaster, masonry/brick, stone fireplaces, and modern high-rise metal studs each require specialized anchors and toggle bolts. We arrive stocked with heavy-duty hardware, laser levels, and stud finders for safe, rock-solid mounting.

faqs.q: Do you handle Samsung Frame TVs, fireplace mounts, and wire concealment?
faqs.a: Yes. We mount TVs of every size (including flush Samsung Frame TVs, MantelMount pull-down arms, full-motion brackets, and ceiling drop-down mounts) and keep cords tidy with cord concealer channels or wall routing.

faqs.q: Do you work in Manhattan and Brooklyn co-ops, condos, and high-rise buildings?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly work in elevator buildings, brownstones, and commercial spaces across Manhattan and Brooklyn, protect hallways and floors cleanly, and coordinate within building work-hour rules.

faqs.q: Do you offer same-day or weekend appointments?
faqs.a: Yes. We operate Monday–Thursday and Saturday–Sunday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, plus Fridays from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Book a slot directly online or call/text (718) 600-6278 for same-day availability.

faqs.q: How do I get a fast, accurate quote before booking?
faqs.a: Text photos of your wall, furniture boxes, or project directly to (718) 600-6278, email handymantj.nyc@gmail.com, or submit our quote form. We give clear, upfront pricing with $20 off for first-time clients.

faqs.q: Are you insured and do you clean up after the job?
faqs.a: Yes — Handyman TJ is fully insured and background-checked. We use drop cloths and floor protection on painting, drywall, and assembly jobs and remove debris and packaging mess from the work area.

faqs.q: Can we schedule recurring interior design installations or property maintenance?
faqs.a: Yes. We partner regularly with NYC interior designers, airbnb hosts, offices, and homeowners for multi-item art walls, showroom builds, apartment turnarounds, and punch-list maintenance.
